verdict.rationale:
Milvus docs explicitly describe pre-filtering: filtering conditions are applied before the ANN search so the search scope is reduced to matching entities, and Milvus Lite confirms metadata filtering is a supported feature across deployment modes. This directly matches the story of combining structured filters with vector search without a separate post-filter step.

missing for 10: independent benchmarks or community evidence quantifying recall/latency impact of filtered search, and documentation detail on filter expression complexity/performance trade-offs.
